about_the_game:
A case that has been cold for over 20 years is suddenly reopened after an astrology enthusiast returns from abroad and discovers a mysterious diary. Forgotten faces, past events, and lost loves resurface one by one... Amid stacks of intricate, perplexing files, travel through time and space, revisiting the past to uncover the concealed secrets of the case. How do the good and evil of human nature intertwine and clash within this mystery? Does the devil truly exist? Were the zodiac sacrifices a mere guise, or a carefully laid trap? Experience a puzzle full of unpredictable twists and endless challenges.

Unravel the mystery and separate truth from falsehood on this journey of discovery. Does the final answer lie in a purgatory of eternal damnation, or a fiery rebirth and redemption? With multiple endings that exceed all expectations, the story's conclusion is yours to uncover in this unique adventure, available on Steam!

✥ Gameplay: Mind-bending puzzles in an immersive world!

✥ Art Style: Delicate & vivid, with diverse & rich scenes

✥ Story: Full of twists & turns, offering a unique narrative journey

✥ Characters: Complex relationships & focus on human nature

✥ Mechanics: Cleverly designed gameplay to test observation

✥ Puzzles: Innovative multiple endings & fresh puzzle-solving experience

    

From an eerie murder scene in a studio to a seaside villa steeped in danger; from police  station archives to the interrogation room, every location is shrouded in mystery, every clue clouded by ambiguity—some may lead you toward the light of truth, while others may drag you deeper into the abyss of uncertainty.The game opens with a mysterious astrological murder case. Though seemingly supernatural and esoteric, it is riddled with traps of human origin... Designed from the player's perspective, experience a thrilling and engaging journey as you unravel the mystery to discover clues. With each new clue, a new piece of the puzzle is revealed, and you inch closer to uncovering a long-buried truth. Every breakthrough brings you one step closer to the shocking secrets behind the Zodiac Murders.

         

This is more than a simple puzzle game—it is a deep exploration of human nature and emotion. Each character has a unique backstory and complex motive. Their fates intertwine like silk thread, caught between love and malice. Together, they weave a torturous, complex web of secrets that reaches to the very depths of the soul. Caught in the push and pull between good and evil, this tangled web raises a crucial question: What role do mysterious forces truly play in fanning the flames? Where did it all begin? What is the truth? Is the devil manipulating everything from the shadows, or does the real abyss lie within the darkness of human nature itself?

          

Unlike the linear style of traditional puzzle games, the multi-thread ending design offers an unprecedented immersive experience. Each ending is more than just a simple variation of the truth; they contain countless possibilities behind the murderer's motives. Every step of the investigation could instantly open a new branch of the plot, leading to different truths. The suspect you were certain of one moment may be completely ruled out in the next second by a single crucial clue, revealing the true culprit was someone else all along! Behind each ending lies a fierce struggle of human nature and shocking revelations hidden in the shadows of time.Do you have the wisdom and courage to uncover every possibility this intricate mystery has to offer?

Ready to step into the world of The Zodiac Mystery? Here, memory is the key to unlocking the truth, and human nature lies at the core of all the tangled complexities. Amidst the haze, can you use your wisdom and patience to identify the true murderer and explore all of the possible answers? Come explore the unknown past and unravel hidden secrets!

short_description: Step into The Zodiac Mystery, where a suspense-filled adventure begins! Players are immersed in a complex and bewildering cold case, searching for clues across time and space. Examine crime scenes, review files, and analyze evidence, following the trail concealed within a celestial haze.
